notes.title: Version updated.More content
notes.content:
In the past month, we have added some new content, today we have updated, The main points of the patch are as follows.
[list]
    [*]3D package: You can carry your medicine with you  and see what you have at any time
    [*]Notepad: Record your goal and the information that you have collected
    [*]Available objects: Such as explosives barrels, toxic cactus, lightning bee, use them to kill monsters, not to kill yourself
    [*]Monsters: New monsters and some monster‘s new actions
    [*]Boss: Improved the final boss behavior
    [*]Setting: About the cue that said "turn to face the sensor"on Oculus,now you can set it display or hide
    [*]Effect: Some optimization, .Such as entering the bullet time when the monster was cut off
    [*]Some bug modifications
[/list]
We hope you enjoy it, and please recommend it to your friend if you love it.thank you very much

notes.title: Version updated.Optimization
notes.content:
Today we have updated，This patch resolves the following issues：
[list]
    [*]We added a hint in the game when you didn't connect to the VR device
    [*]Fixed the issue that crossbow cann't work: press the Home button when you reload the crossbow
    [*]Added some game tips: kill the last boss, pick the fruit and so on
    [*]We found that we accidentally opened the motion blur in Oculus, so many players said they saw the weird ghosting of all graphic elements when moving their head. now we fixed it
[/list]
We're still optimizing a lot of things,like movement and assassination coexist, 3D package, trigger button, the audio,Npc and so on
Please give us more time and suggests,and recommend it to your friend if you love it.thank you

notes.title: Version updated.Optimization
notes.content:
Thank you for your attention to The Ranger:Lost Tribe, we have received a lot of suggestions, and we are dealing with these issues
We have updated, as follows：
[list]
    [*] The guides were modified when players use Oculus Touch
    [*] We found it hard for players to throw spears with Oculus Touch,we fixed it
    [*]We cancelled the cue to say "turn to face the sensor", when you have more than 2 sensors
[/list]
We're still optimizing……
To be continued
